logical_reasoning.question: Five developers complete a project in 10 days. How many days will ten developers take?
logical_reasoning.answer: Assuming equal productivity, total work is 5 multiplied by 10, which is 50 developer-days. Ten developers will complete it in 5 days.

scenario_evaluation.question: Your application becomes slow after several users log in. What would you do?
scenario_evaluation.answer: I would first identify whether the issue is in the frontend, backend or database. I would inspect API response times, database queries and server logs. Then I would optimize the bottleneck and test the application under concurrent user load.
